code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, networkx as nx, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80}
AA3=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL'.split())
APOLAR_ATOM=lambda nm,el: el=='C' or (el=='S')
def parse(t,chain='A',trim=None):
    A=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if not l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3 or l[16] not in (' ','A') or l[21]!=chain: continue
        nm=l[12:16].strip(); el=(l[76:78].strip().upper() or nm[0])
        if el=='H': continue
        ri=int(l[22:26])
        if trim and not(trim[0]<=ri<=trim[1]): continue
        A.append((nm,rn,ri,float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),el))
    return A
def sasa(co,rad,n=160,probe=1.4):
    gr=(1+5**0.5)/2; i=np.arange(n)+0.5
    th=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); ph=2*np.pi*i/gr
    sph=np.stack([np.sin(th)*np.cos(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(th)],1)
    R=rad+probe; tr=cKDTree(co); out=np.zeros(len(co)); mx=R.max()
    for k in range(len(co)):
        nb=[j for j in tr.query_ball_point(co[k],R[k]+mx) if j!=k]
        pts=co[k]+sph*R[k]
        acc=np.ones(n,bool) if not nb else np.all(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-co[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)>=R[nb][None,:],axis=1)
        out[k]=4*np.pi*R[k]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
def patch(atoms,ser):
    co=np.array([[a[3],a[4],a[5]] for a in atoms]); rad=np.array([VDW.get(a[6],1.7) for a in atoms])
    og=np.array([[a[3],a[4],a[5]] for a in atoms if a[2]==ser and a[0]=='OG'][0])
    sa=sasa(co,rad)
    exp=[i for i in range(len(atoms)) if sa[i]>5.0 and APOLAR_ATOM(atoms[i][0],atoms[i][6])]
    G=nx.Graph(); G.add_nodes_from(exp)
    sub=cKDTree(co[exp])
    for a,b in sub.query_pairs(5.0): G.add_edge(exp[a],exp[b])
    comps=sorted(nx.connected_components(G),key=lambda c:sum(sa[i] for i in c),reverse=True)
    big=comps[0]; area=sum(sa[i] for i in big)
    dmin=min(np.linalg.norm(co[i]-og) for i in big)
    # patch area restricted to within 18 A of the nucleophile
    near=sum(sa[i] for i in big if np.linalg.norm(co[i]-og)<18)
    return dict(total_sasa=sa.sum(), largest_apolar_patch=area, patch_dist_to_OG=dmin, patch_near_site=near)
SET=[('FSH3 (AF)','af','Q99369',117,(3,230)),('FSH1 (AF)','af','P38777',110,None),('OVCA2 (AF)','af','Q8WZ82',119,None),
     ('APT1 1FJ2','pdb','1FJ2',114,None),('APT2 5SYM','pdb','5SYM',119,None),('LPLA2 4X90','pdb','4X90',165,None),
     ('MGL 3HJU','pdb','3HJU',122,None),('BioH 1M33','pdb','1M33',82,None),('SFGH 3FCX','pdb','3FCX',149,None),
     ('TLL 1DT3','pdb','1DT3',146,None)]
rows=[]
for nm,k,acc,ser,trim in SET:
    u=(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb' if k=='af' else f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{acc}.pdb')
    at=parse(requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=120).text,trim=trim)
    p=patch(at,ser); p['structure']=nm; rows.append(p)
P=pd.DataFrame(rows)[['structure','total_sasa','largest_apolar_patch','patch_near_site','patch_dist_to_OG']]
P[['total_sasa','largest_apolar_patch','patch_near_site','patch_dist_to_OG']]=P[['total_sasa','largest_apolar_patch','patch_near_site','patch_dist_to_OG']].round(1)
print(P.to_string(index=False))
P.to_csv('fsh3_surface_patch.csv',index=False)

T=pd.read_csv('fsh3_pocket_conservation.csv')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4.4))
x=np.arange(len(T))
ax.bar(x-0.2,T['identity'],0.4,label='identity to FSH3',color='#2b6cb0')
ax.bar(x+0.2,T['class_conserv'],0.4,label='residue-class conservation',color='#f6ad55')
lab=[f"{r.FSH3}{r.pos}" for r in T.itertuples()]
cat={117,180,209,12,116,118,153}
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
for i,r in enumerate(T.itertuples()):
    if r.pos in cat: ax.get_xticklabels()[i].set_color('#c53030')
ax.axhline(0.55,color='grey',ls=':',lw=1)
ax.text(0.2,0.57,'background mean class conservation = 0.55',fontsize=8,color='grey')
ax.set_ylabel('fraction of 65 fungal orthologs'); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05)
ax.set_title('FSH3 pocket-lining residues: the conserved core is catalytic (red labels), the candidate headgroup residues are not',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(loc='upper right',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
